name: block-landing-hero
summary: Landing page hero with eyebrow, heading, calls to action, optional media, and a feature grid.
description: A Web block for the top of a public landing page: an eyebrow badge, the page heading, supporting copy, primary and secondary calls to action, optional media beside the copy on wide screens, and a responsive feature grid with decorative icons. Built from the Badge primitive and theme tokens; all copy and actions arrive through props and it fetches nothing.
use_when: a public home or product page needs a headline section with calls to action
the builder asks for a landing page, hero, or marketing section
key features should be presented in a grid under the headline
